mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases above 2% do not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the unemployment rate increase does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with supply chain disruptions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with aggressive tightening.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three months signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or HOUST growth does not correlate with positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with economic contraction.
